urls.title: SoundCloud URLs
urls.description: Track, user (artist) or playlist/album URLs to resolve, e.g. https://soundcloud.com/edsheeran/shape-of-you (track), https://soundcloud.com/edsheeran (user) or https://soundcloud.com/user/sets/name (playlist). Each resolved object is one dataset item.

search.title: Search keyword
search.description: Optional. Keyword to search SoundCloud for. Combine with searchType and maxItems. Leave empty to only resolve the URLs above.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: What the search keyword looks for: tracks, users (artists) or playlists.

maxItems.title: Max search results
maxItems.description: How many search results to return (newest page first). Only applies to the search keyword; URLs above are always resolved. Each item is billed as one event.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Not needed normally; use Apify Proxy only if SoundCloud starts rate-limiting very large runs.
